mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline from the previous month, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO below 110.0), manufacturing supply constraints intensify, leading to higher input costs and reduced corporate margins, which cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO < 110.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real consumer spending (RSAFS) relative to its 12-month moving average signals stronger household purchasing power, which boosts corporate revenue growth and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS has increased for at least 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad-based supply shock that disrupts manufacturing and construction sectors, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both INDPRO and HOUST decline from the previous month, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.05 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of rising unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5% and increasing for 3 months), labor market weakness reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE > 4.5% and rising for 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.05.
